key_insight: SOLID turns a model’s own solver-generated artifacts into dense self-training signals, enabling OR-language-model improvement without verified answers or external evaluators.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable training recipe for deployment-facing optimization assistants where expert labels and process-level judges are too costly or unavailable.
method: Run multiple rollouts for a candidate OR program.
Cluster rollout objectives and pick the majority-group artifact as a pseudo-reference.
Update the model with group-relative advantages plus dense self-supervision from solver artifacts.
evidence_signal: Across multiple OR benchmarks, SOLID improved solution accuracy for both general-purpose and OR-tuned models compared with outcome-only group-relative training.
watch_item: Majority-vote pseudo-references may be sensitive to rollout diversity and solver behavior, so poor clustering or noisy artifacts could reinforce errors.
paper_title: Beyond Verified Answers: Solver-Informed Self-Distillation for Bootstrapping Operations Research Language Models
